plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai script replayed outdated structural CSS selectors that selected the 'Solutions' dropdown instead of 'Developers', navigating to an unexpected solutions URL and failing the URL assertion.
observedIndicators: The cached page.ai replay script used a stale structural selector (#nav > ... > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) which clicked the 'Solutions' nav button instead of 'Developers'.
The page navigated to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/', causing the URL assertion to fail.

The page.ai instruction ('Click on the Developers dropdown menu, then click into to the Documentation option') represents a flexible semantic objective that will succeed once fresh selectors are generated.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry test execution
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached page.ai instructions for checkly.test.ts so Donobu re-analyzes the page DOM and targets the correct 'Developers' menu item.

plan.notes: Clearing the stale page.ai cache will allow the AI driver to freshly locate the 'Developers' button and navigate to '/docs/'.
